The Dow Jones, S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite all gained at the open, extending gains across major US indexes.

items.teaser: Prestige Estates has finalized a significant joint development agreement for a housing project in Gurugram, aiming to generate an impress…
items.story: Prestige Estates has finalized a significant joint development agreement for a housing project in Gurugram, aiming to generate an impressive revenue of Rs 5,600 crore. This development will span across a substantial 17.14-acre land parcel in Sector 109. As part of their growth strategy, the company is also extending its footprint in the Delhi-NCR area, with additional projects underway in Ghaziabad and Noida.

items.headline: India bonds pare gains as oil spike tames FCNR boost
items.teaser: Early Thursday trading saw Indian government bonds lose their initial gains as stronger dollar inflows were overshadowed by soaring oil p…
items.story: Early Thursday trading saw Indian government bonds lose their initial gains as stronger dollar inflows were overshadowed by soaring oil prices. Traders covering short positions led to better performance in shorter maturities. Abundant liquidity helped reduce overnight indexed swap rates, but the spike in oil prices heightened concerns about India's inflation trajectory and fiscal integrity.

items.story: Zerodha founder Nithin Kamath recalled how a 15-year-old media appearance helped boost the broker’s account openings in its early days. He also revealed that he used the pseudonym “Sachin” and even faked an accent while speaking to a journalist. Kamath later turned to social media as traditional media’s influence waned.

items.story: NSE is inching closer to its much-awaited IPO as SEBI nears approval of its DRHP. While unlisted NSE shares remain 17% below their peak, BSE has corrected nearly 29% from its 52-week high. Experts compare the two exchanges on valuations, earnings, liquidity and growth prospects to assess which offers better value.

items.story: വിവാഹത്തിന് മുമ്പ് എച്ച്.ഐ.വി ടെസ്റ്റ്; വൈദികന്റെ പരാമർശത്തിൽ വിവാദം, നല്ല ഉദ്ദേശ്യത്തോടെ പറഞ്ഞതെന്ന്... Madhyamamവിവാഹത്തിന് മുമ്പ് എച്ച്.ഐ.വി ടെസ്റ്റ് നടത്തണം; വിവാദ പ്രസ്താവനയുമായി മാര്‍ത്തോമ്മാ സഭ വൈദിക ട്രസ്റ്റി DoolNewsവിവാഹത്തിനു മുന്‍പ് എച്ച്‌ഐ‌വി ടെസ്റ്റ് നടത്തണം: മാര്‍ത്തോമ്മാസഭ വൈദിക ട്രസ്റ്റി manoramanews.com'മാർത്തോമാ സഭയിൽ വിവാഹത്തിന് മുമ്പ് വധൂവരന്മാർക്ക് എച്ച്‌ഐവി ടെസ്റ്റ് നിർബന്ധമാക്കണം'; വൈദിക ട്രസ്റ്റി Media OneRev. Dr K Thomas | വിവാദ പരാമർശവുമായി മാർത്തോമ സഭാ വൈദിക ട്രസ്റ്റി

items.headline: 'Green thumb' molecule helps leaf stalks grow in crowded conditions
items.teaser: Potassium (K) is one of the three essential nutrients for plants. It plays a critical role in a wide range of processes, including cell g…
items.story: Potassium (K) is one of the three essential nutrients for plants. It plays a critical role in a wide range of processes, including cell growth, photosynthesis and regulation of water balance. Plants take up K from the soil and circulate it throughout their bodies via molecules called K+ channels. The function of one such K+ channel (called AKT5) in the model plant Arabidopsis thaliana has remained a mystery, despite more than 30 years of study.

items.headline: The universe has plenty of hydrogen. So why is star formation collapsing?
items.teaser: Star formation across the universe has fallen dramatically over the past 4.5 billion years, but astronomers have uncovered a surprising t…
items.story: Star formation across the universe has fallen dramatically over the past 4.5 billion years, but astronomers have uncovered a surprising twist: the supply of neutral hydrogen, a key ingredient for making stars, has barely declined. Using China’s FAST radio telescope and data from roughly 2.5 million galaxies observed by DESI, researchers found that star formation was about 2.5 times higher 4.5 billion years ago, while neutral hydrogen levels were only about 1.4 times higher.
